attributes.title: 2027 ANPD Aspire Convention
attributes.summary:
The Association for Nursing Professional Development holds its 2027 Aspire Convention from April 4 to 8, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency New Orleans. The five-day program is aimed at nurses who run orientation, onboarding, competency and continuing education programs in hospitals and health systems.

The main convention carries 19.75 ANCC-accredited NCPD contact hours. Optional pre-convention workshops on Monday, April 5, add 3 contact hours each, and a two-day NPD certification preparation course adds 14 contact hours.

Full registration is $750 for members and $1,030 for non-members, with one rate regardless of when you register; a single day costs $400, and groups of three or more pay less. The hotel block at $279 per night closes March 12, 2027, the same day as the last date for a refund.
